title: Scenic Getaway to Japan | A Fusion of Ancient Traditions & Modern Wonders
highlights: Immerse yourself in the beauty of Japan, where Tokyo's lively energy, Kyoto's serene shrines, and Hiroshima's compelling history offer a journey like no other.
Marvel at Five-Story Pagoda at Senso-ji Temple, which embodies the elements of earth, water, fire, wind, and sky, blending ancient symbolism with architectural beauty.
Visit Itsukushima Shrine to witness the iconic "floating" Torii gate that seems to rise from the waters at high tide, while enjoying panoramic views of the stunning Seto Inland Sea.
Wander through Nara Park and interact with over 1000 free-roaming Sika deer, considered the messengers of the gods, creating an unforgettable and interactive experience.
Explore Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, where the soft rustling of bamboo leaves and the play of light and shadows offer a soothing escape from the urban rush of Kyoto.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the tour/premises.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
Bring a portable charger for your devices, as power outlets may be scarce. Carry an adapter for Type A or Type B sockets.
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, traditional house or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.
It's not customary to leave a tip for your server in Japan, as tipping isn't a standard practice in restaurants here.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel for check in. After a bit of relaxation, step out to explore the vibrant city at your leisure. You can immerse yourself in the shopping & entertainment heaven at Ginza or spend some peaceful time at Sumida Park. For a unique experience, visit the Samurai Theatre for live performances or stroll across the iconic Rainbow Bridge, offering stunning views of Tokyo Bay, among other attraction points.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour by Bus
days.desc: In the morning, head to LOVE Sculpture & board the transfer for Tokyo city tour. Begin by visiting Meiji Jingu Shrine, known for its peaceful ambience. Next, explore Imperial Palace, known as Japan’s monarchy, followed by a visit to Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest temple. Continue to Tokyo Skytree, offering city views from its observation deck & Odaiba, offering various shopping & entertainment options. Later, get driven 1-chōme-7-2 Nishishinjuku. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After checkout, reach Tokyo Station on your own to board the bullet train to Hiroshima. Upon arrival, reach the hotel on your own & check in at your hotel. Later, you can spend the day at your leisure. You can visit Shukkeien Garden, a serene, circuit-style garden featuring a central pond & beautiful bridges. Alternatively, explore Hiroshima Castle, also known as the "Carp Castle," where you can climb to the top for stunning panoramic views of the city, among other famous places.

days.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima Island Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Head to the pickup point, Hotel Granvia, on your own for an enriching Hiroshima & Miyajima tour. Begin with a visit to Peace Memorial Park, a known symbol of hope & peace. Next, marvel at the Atomic Bomb Dome, an iconic reminder of Hiroshima’s tragic history. Then, board a ferry to Miyajima Island, where you’ll encounter the stunning Itsukushima Shrine & its famous vermillion-red floating torii gates. Afterward, get transferred to Hiroshima Station, from where return to the hotel on your own.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After you check out, head to Hiroshima Station to board the bullet train to Kyoto. Upon arrival, head to the hotel on your own & check in. After you relax, spend the day at your leisure. You can visit Nijo Castle, famous for its nightingale floors that chirp as you walk. Alternatively, dive into Japan’s rich heritage at Kyoto National Museum, home to traditional arts or for manga fans, the International Manga Museum offers an extensive collection of comics.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Explore the highlights of Kyoto & Nara on a sightseeing tour. Begin by boarding the transfer from Kyoto Station after which you'll be transferred to the first stop- Kinkakuji Temple, known for its gold leaf exterior. Then, admire the beauty of Arashiyama, where you can stroll through the iconic bamboo forest. Continue to Nara Park, where you can interact with the friendly Sika deer & visit Todai-ji Temple. Later, get driven to Kyoto Station, from where head back to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Kyoto Departure/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Make the most of your time in Kyoto & explore the city at your own pace. You can visit the tranquil Rurikō-in Temple, where you can spend time in peace or head to Kiyomizu-dera for stunning panoramic views of Kyoto. If you prefer, you can wander through the vibrant Gion district, known for its geisha culture & traditional wooden houses, or admire the picturesque Katsura River from the iconic Togetsukyo Bridge, among other attraction points.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Departure Day
days.desc: Reflect on the amazing experiences you've had in Japan. After breakfast, check out from the hotel & get driven to Kansai International Airport to board your flight back home. This marks the end of your trip.
